competitors.gap: Evergreen class list from the ADA; no dated 2026 approvals (Ozempic pill, weekly insulins, Mounjaro CV indication) and no pipeline.
Consumer roundup; does not cite the October 2026 ADA/EASD consensus on early SGLT2/GLP-1 use, which is the real answer to the metformin question.
General research overview; no product-level approval dates or trial figures.

information_gain: Answers 'what is replacing metformin' from the ADA Standards 2026 and the 2 October 2026 ADA/EASD consensus, beside a dated table of every 2026 US approval, which no ranking page combines.
serp_format_rewarded: AI Overview and site links on a health-authority SERP; short direct answers plus dated tables, sourced to ADA and manufacturer releases.
